component.name: MainScene
component.script:
sub init() m.task = createObject("roSGNode", "WorkerTask") m.task.observeField("ready", "onReady") m.task.observeField("report", "onReport") m.task.control = "run" end sub
' 99 small writes (~990K chars, under the 1M batch soft cap) then one 15.8MB write: ' each fits the 16MB buffer alone, but packed together they exceed it. sub onReady() piece = String(10000, "a") for i = 1 to 99 m.task.request = piece end for m.task.request = String(15800000, "b") print "SCENE SENT: small=99 big=1" end sub
sub onReport(event as object) print "TASK SAW: "; event.getData() m.top.done = true end sub
